Spacecraft name PR CubeSat (Puerto Rico CubeSat)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status cancelled
Organisation University of Puerto Rico
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters US
Partners University of Puerto Rico-Mayaguez (UPRM), Inter American University of Puerto Rico- Bayamon (UIPRB), University of Puerto Rico-Rio Piedras (UPRRP), University of Turabo
Oneliner

Educational training and demonstrate CubeSat platform.
Description

Main objective is to promote interdisciplinary research in the area of aerospace systems with the collaboration of graduate and undergraduate students from electrical, mechanical and computer engineering departments.

The multidisciplinary process consists of the design, simulation, and construction of each subsystem of the Cubesat. Each university is responsible of building at least one subsystem. Carry two scientific instruments, CARLO (Charge Analyzer Responsive to Local Oscillation) and GimmeRF (Gimme Radio Frequency). CARLO will measure charged ion turbulence from 0 to 10 kHz, which affects radio propagation in the 0 to 30 MHz radio band measured by GimmeRF.
